blocks.html:
In systems with appliances above the lowest floor where such appliances are designed to operate utilizing fuel stored above the lowest floor, piping diameters shall not exceed 4 inches (101.6 mm).
   Exception: Where an applicant demonstrates, by calculations in the construction documents, that a greater diameter is necessary to ensure the proper flow for the functioning of the system.
